proof_scope: Failure-backed agentic workflows through real Pi, CLI, filesystem and Memory entrypoints; no mock-Pi callback runners or fabricated PASS proof files.

claims.proves: Only the named workflows and their independently read-back effects. Each capability requires live evidence; fixture counts do not establish ecosystem readiness.
claims.does_not_prove: All parser variants, every escalation provider, interactive review-picker UX, OS-level tamper resistance, universal instruction obedience, or arbitrary project completion. Faults are explicitly injected into real runtime messages; the audio case uses real CLI/file operations rather than a new voice render.

capability_claims.description: An advisory question mentioning skills produces one answer without tool calls or report retries.
A corrupted final report is corrected once without restarting task work.
Six identical continuation reports lead to a completed, independently checked artifact.
An unresolved proof reference is rejected, recorded, and corrected using existing evidence.
Duplicate status keys are rejected through the actual Pi conversation path.
Missing done verification is rejected and corrected without running new tools.
Misleading prose cannot override valid status data in the real renderer.
A terminal status report for a human question must carry a first-class answer and render it before status metadata.
Immutable-goal reports must put COMPLETE, NOT_COMPLETE, or NEEDS_HUMAN in the first-class answer headline so the result cannot be buried under proof metadata.
Collaborator-mediated closure requires a typed peer acceptance receipt, not implementer self-closure.
Unapproved tool calls cannot write artifacts or add checks; accepted work stays terminal.
Separate real sessions retain isolated failure evidence; real captured feedback reaches Memory and is independently recalled.
The real audio installer preserves approved source bytes and refuses a repeated-loop replacement.

Escalation is data-gated and live-receipt-gated: real Brave results precede the configured first Ask API handler, and WebGPT requires typed brave-search plus Ask parent refs before terminal acceptance.
Done status requires each verified claim to be backed by one valid proof record; unrelated text, malformed JSON, unknown receipt schemas, and failed receipts cannot authorize completion.
Read-only shame preflight uses the same stop-boundary checker and matches reason codes before terminal retries are consumed.
Shame recovery separates format repair, existing-proof substitution, missing evidence, validator failure, unresolved work, and accepted-task cases with typed decisions.
Shame retry packets are typed, byte-bounded, tool-free for format repair, and carry an admitted evidence snapshot with proof schema and digest.
A typed ticket closure receipt can authorize a final shame done status while raw GitHub issue JSON cannot.
The stop-boundary checker classifies the 2026-09-08 spiral candidate shapes correctly and accepts the documented compliant shape, so an agent following the compliance recipe cannot spiral.
Shame retry exhaustion is retained as a distinct failure event and converted into a ticket request for agent-work project-watchdog repair routing.
Schema-passing status reports preserve concrete operational anchors in accepted data and compact rejection/retry packets hash raw diagnostics.

cases.name: live-escalation-receipt-chain
command:
from __future__ import annotations
import hashlib, json, os, subprocess, sys, uuid
from datetime import datetime, timezone
from pathlib import Path
from typing import Any
ROOT = Path('/home/graham/workspace/experiments/agent-skills')
RUN_ID = 'live-' + uuid.uuid4().hex[:10]
RUN_ROOT = ROOT / '.artifacts' / 'shame' / 'live-escalation-receipt-chain-runs' / RUN_ID
RUN_ROOT.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
RESULT_PATH = ROOT / '.artifacts' / 'shame' / 'live-escalation-receipt-chain-result.json'
GOAL_HASH = 'sha256:' + hashlib.sha256(('shame live escalation receipt chain ' + RUN_ID).encode()).hexdigest()
STATUS_SCHEMA = ROOT / 'skills' / 'shame' / 'scripts' / 'agent_status_schema.py'
COMPILER = ROOT / 'extensions' / 'pi' / 'lazy-report-shame-shame-shame' / 'compile-status-command.mjs'
ASK_RUN = ROOT / 'skills' / 'ask' / 'run.sh'
BRAVE_RUN = ROOT / 'skills' / 'brave-search' / 'run.sh'
BROWSER_PREFLIGHT = ROOT / 'skills' / 'ask' / 'scripts' / 'browser_prompt_preflight.py'
CHAIN_ENV = {'LRSSS_PROJECT_AGENT_FAMILY': 'openai', 'LRSSS_AVAILABLE_ASK_HANDLERS': json.dumps(['claude-fable-low', 'gpt-5.5-high'])}

def write_json(path: Path, payload: dict[str, Any]) -> None:
    path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    path.write_text(json.dumps(payload, indent=2, sort_keys=True) + '\n', encoding='utf-8')

def sha256_file(path: Path) -> str:
    return 'sha256:' + hashlib.sha256(path.read_bytes()).hexdigest()

def fail(message: str, evidence: Any = None) -> None:
    detail = {'message': message, 'evidence': evidence}
    write_json(RUN_ROOT / 'failure.json', {'schema': 'lazy_report_shame.live_escalation_receipt_chain.v1', 'status': 'FAIL', 'detail': detail})
    raise SystemExit(json.dumps(detail, indent=2, sort_keys=True))

def require(condition: bool, message: str, evidence: Any = None) -> None:
    if not condition:
        fail(message, evidence)

def run_cmd(cmd: list[str], *, cwd: Path = ROOT, timeout: int = 120, stdin: str | None = None, env_extra: dict[str, str] | None = None) -> subprocess.CompletedProcess[str]:
    env = os.environ.copy()
    if env_extra:
        env.update(env_extra)
    proc = subprocess.run(cmd, cwd=str(cwd), input=stdin, text=True, capture_output=True, timeout=timeout, env=env, check=False)
    return proc

def parse_first_json(text: str) -> Any:
    decoder = json.JSONDecoder()
    for idx, char in enumerate(text):
        if char not in '[{':
            continue
        try:
            value, _end = decoder.raw_decode(text[idx:])
        except json.JSONDecodeError:
            continue
        return value
    fail('no JSON object found in command output', text[-1000:])

def validate_status(payload: dict[str, Any]) -> dict[str, Any]:
    proc = run_cmd(['uv', 'run', '--with', 'pydantic', 'python3', str(STATUS_SCHEMA), 'validate', '-'], stdin=json.dumps(payload), env_extra=CHAIN_ENV)
    out = parse_first_json(proc.stdout)
    out['exit_code'] = proc.returncode
    return out

def compile_status(payload: dict[str, Any]) -> dict[str, Any]:
    proc = run_cmd(['node', str(COMPILER)], stdin=json.dumps(payload), env_extra=CHAIN_ENV)
    require(proc.returncode == 0, 'status command compiler failed', {'stderr': proc.stderr[-1000:], 'stdout': proc.stdout[-1000:]})
    out = parse_first_json(proc.stdout)
    out['exit_code'] = proc.returncode
    return out

def parent_for_envelope(ref: dict[str, str]) -> dict[str, str]:
    return {k: ref[k] for k in ('receipt_id', 'expected_schema', 'expected_producer', 'digest')}

def envelope(receipt_id: str, producer: str, payload_schema: str, payload: dict[str, Any], parent_refs: list[dict[str, str]] | None = None) -> dict[str, str]:
    doc = {'schema': 'pi.receipt_envelope.v1', 'receipt_id': receipt_id, 'payload_schema': payload_schema, 'producer': producer, 'emitted_at': datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat(), 'goal_hash': GOAL_HASH, 'parent_refs': parent_refs or [], 'payload': payload}
    path = RUN_ROOT / f'{receipt_id}.envelope.json'
    write_json(path, doc)
    return {'receipt_id': receipt_id, 'receipt_path': str(path), 'expected_schema': payload_schema, 'expected_producer': producer, 'digest': sha256_file(path)}

def latest_run_dir(output_root: Path) -> Path:
    dirs = [p for p in output_root.iterdir() if p.is_dir()]
    require(bool(dirs), 'Ask output root has no run directory', str(output_root))
    return max(dirs, key=lambda p: p.stat().st_mtime)

def run_ask(handler: str, token: str, output_root: Path, extra: list[str] | None = None, timeout: int = 1200) -> dict[str, Any]:
    cmd = [str(ASK_RUN), 'tau-dag', f'Reply with exactly: {token}', '--repo', 'local/agent-skills', '--target', 'shame-live-escalation-receipt-chain', '--immutable-goal', 'Return the requested token or a typed blocker.', '--handler', handler, '--execute', '--json', '--run-output-root', str(output_root)]
    if extra:
        cmd.extend(extra)
    proc = run_cmd(cmd, cwd=ASK_RUN.parent, timeout=timeout)
    require(proc.returncode == 0, f'Ask {handler} run failed', {'stderr': proc.stderr[-2000:], 'stdout': proc.stdout[-2000:]})
    payload = parse_first_json(proc.stdout)
    run_dir = Path(str(((payload.get('bundle') or {}).get('run_dir')) or latest_run_dir(output_root)))
    node_dir = run_dir / 'node-artifacts' / ('handler-' + handler.replace('.', '-'))
    receipt_path = node_dir / 'node-receipt.json'
    response_path = node_dir / 'response.md'
    handoff_path = node_dir / 'handoff.json'
    require(receipt_path.is_file(), f'missing {handler} node receipt', str(receipt_path))
    require(response_path.is_file(), f'missing {handler} response', str(response_path))
    require(handoff_path.is_file(), f'missing {handler} handoff', str(handoff_path))
    receipt = json.loads(receipt_path.read_text(encoding='utf-8'))
    response = response_path.read_text(encoding='utf-8', errors='replace')
    handoff = json.loads(handoff_path.read_text(encoding='utf-8'))
    require(payload.get('status') == 'PASS' and payload.get('ok') is True, f'Ask {handler} CLI result not PASS', payload.get('status'))
    require(receipt.get('schema') == 'ask.tau_dag_handler_receipt.v1' and receipt.get('status') == 'PASS', f'Ask {handler} node receipt not PASS', receipt)
    require(receipt.get('live') is True and receipt.get('mocked') is False and receipt.get('provider_live') is True, f'Ask {handler} receipt is not live provider evidence', receipt)
    require(token in response, f'Ask {handler} response missing token', response[-500:])
    require(handoff.get('schema') == 'tau.agent_handoff.v1' and (handoff.get('result') or {}).get('status') == 'PASS', f'Ask {handler} handoff not PASS', handoff)
    return {'cli': payload, 'run_dir': str(run_dir), 'node_dir': str(node_dir), 'receipt_path': str(receipt_path), 'response_path': str(response_path), 'handoff_path': str(handoff_path), 'receipt': receipt, 'handoff': handoff, 'response_chars': len(response)}

brave_query = 'OpenAI agentic evaluations live receipt chain ' + RUN_ID
brave_proc = run_cmd([str(BRAVE_RUN), 'web', brave_query, '--count', '1'], timeout=90)
require(brave_proc.returncode == 0, 'Brave web search command failed', {'stderr': brave_proc.stderr[-1000:], 'stdout': brave_proc.stdout[-1000:]})
brave_result = parse_first_json(brave_proc.stdout)
brave_raw_path = RUN_ROOT / 'brave-web-results.raw.json'
write_json(brave_raw_path, brave_result)
brave_results = brave_result.get('results') or []
require(brave_result.get('query') == brave_query and len(brave_results) >= 1 and str(brave_results[0].get('url', '')).startswith('http'), 'Brave web search did not return a live result', brave_result)
brave_ref = envelope('brave-' + RUN_ID, 'brave-search', 'brave_search.web_results.v1', {'schema': 'brave_search.web_results.v1', 'status': 'PASS', 'command': [str(BRAVE_RUN), 'web', brave_query, '--count', '1'], 'result_path': str(brave_raw_path), 'result_count': len(brave_results), 'first_url': brave_results[0].get('url'), 'raw_sha256': sha256_file(brave_raw_path)})

needs_agent_status = {'schema': 'pi.agent_status.v1', 'goal': 'retain live escalation receipt chain', 'goal_hash': GOAL_HASH, 'state': 'needs_agent', 'changed': ['scoped Shame eval catalog live escalation case'], 'needs_agent': {'project_agent_family': 'openai', 'handler': 'claude-fable-low', 'question': 'Use the configured first Ask API route.', 'parent_refs': [brave_ref]}}
needs_agent_validation = validate_status(needs_agent_status)
require(needs_agent_validation.get('exit_code') == 0 and needs_agent_validation.get('valid') is True, 'needs_agent status did not validate after live Brave receipt', needs_agent_validation)
needs_agent_compiled = compile_status(needs_agent_status)
compiled_agent_command = needs_agent_compiled.get('command') or ''
require('skills/ask/run.sh tau-dag' in compiled_agent_command and "--handler 'claude-fable-low'" in compiled_agent_command, 'needs_agent did not compile to first Ask API handler', compiled_agent_command)

ask_api = run_ask('claude-fable-low', 'ASK-FIRST-' + RUN_ID.upper(), RUN_ROOT / 'ask-api', ['--allow-provider-calls', '--require-provider-calls'], timeout=900)
ask_transport = (((ask_api['receipt'].get('provider_receipt') or {}).get('transport')))
require(ask_transport == 'scillm.chat', 'first Ask API route did not use scillm.chat', ask_api['receipt'].get('provider_receipt'))
ask_handoff_payload = ask_api['handoff']
ask_ref = envelope('ask-first-' + RUN_ID, 'ask', 'tau.agent_handoff.v1', ask_handoff_payload, [parent_for_envelope(brave_ref)])

needs_webgpt_status = {'schema': 'pi.agent_status.v1', 'goal': 'retain live escalation receipt chain', 'goal_hash': GOAL_HASH, 'state': 'needs_webgpt', 'changed': ['scoped Shame eval catalog live escalation case'], 'needs_webgpt': {'question': 'Use the browser WebGPT route after Brave and Ask receipts.', 'parent_refs': [brave_ref, ask_ref]}}
needs_webgpt_validation = validate_status(needs_webgpt_status)
require(needs_webgpt_validation.get('exit_code') == 0 and needs_webgpt_validation.get('valid') is True, 'needs_webgpt status did not validate after typed Brave and Ask parents', needs_webgpt_validation)
needs_webgpt_compiled = compile_status(needs_webgpt_status)
compiled_webgpt_command = needs_webgpt_compiled.get('command') or ''
require('skills/ask/run.sh tau-dag' in compiled_webgpt_command and "--handler 'webgpt'" in compiled_webgpt_command and '--attach-file' in compiled_webgpt_command, 'needs_webgpt did not compile to WebGPT with attached typed parents', compiled_webgpt_command)

webgpt_prompt = 'Reply with exactly: WEBGPT-' + RUN_ID.upper()
preflight = run_cmd(['python3', str(BROWSER_PREFLIGHT), '--prompt', webgpt_prompt], timeout=30)
require(preflight.returncode == 0, 'WebGPT prompt preflight failed', {'stderr': preflight.stderr, 'stdout': preflight.stdout})
webgpt = run_ask('webgpt', 'WEBGPT-' + RUN_ID.upper(), RUN_ROOT / 'webgpt', ['--browser-tab-lifecycle', 'fresh-temporary', '--poll-timeout-seconds', '900', '--browser-lock-timeout', '900'], timeout=1200)
webgpt_provider = webgpt['receipt'].get('provider_receipt') or {}
require(webgpt_provider.get('transport') == 'webgpt.submit' and webgpt_provider.get('provider_transport') == '$surf', 'WebGPT route did not use Surf browser transport', webgpt_provider)
provider_result_path = Path(str(webgpt_provider.get('surf_provider_result_path') or ''))
require(provider_result_path.is_file(), 'WebGPT provider result path missing', str(provider_result_path))
provider_result = json.loads(provider_result_path.read_text(encoding='utf-8'))
require(provider_result.get('schema') == 'surf.provider_result.v1' and provider_result.get('success') is True and provider_result.get('proof_status') == 'response_proven', 'WebGPT Surf provider result did not prove response', provider_result)
webgpt_ref = envelope('webgpt-' + RUN_ID, 'ask', 'tau.agent_handoff.v1', webgpt['handoff'], [parent_for_envelope(brave_ref), parent_for_envelope(ask_ref)])

terminal_payload = {'schema': 'lazy_report_shame.live_escalation_receipt_chain.v1', 'status': 'terminal_acceptance_pass', 'live': True, 'mocked': False, 'verified_command': 'live-escalation-receipt-chain terminal acceptance', 'verified_result': 'terminal_acceptance_pass', 'run_id': RUN_ID, 'goal_hash': GOAL_HASH, 'brave_parent_ref': brave_ref, 'ask_parent_ref': ask_ref, 'webgpt_receipt_ref': webgpt_ref, 'ask_handler': 'claude-fable-low', 'webgpt_transport': 'webgpt.submit'}
terminal_ref = envelope('terminal-acceptance-' + RUN_ID, 'shame', 'lazy_report_shame.live_escalation_receipt_chain.v1', terminal_payload, [parent_for_envelope(brave_ref), parent_for_envelope(ask_ref), parent_for_envelope(webgpt_ref)])
done_status = {'schema': 'pi.agent_status.v1', 'goal': 'retain live escalation receipt chain', 'goal_hash': GOAL_HASH, 'state': 'done', 'changed': ['scoped Shame eval catalog live escalation case'], 'verified': [{'command': 'live-escalation-receipt-chain terminal acceptance', 'result': 'terminal_acceptance_pass'}], 'proof': [terminal_ref['receipt_path']], 'receipts': [brave_ref['receipt_path'], ask_ref['receipt_path'], webgpt_ref['receipt_path'], terminal_ref['receipt_path']], 'nodes': [{'id': 'brave-search', 'status': 'PASS', 'receipt': brave_ref['receipt_path']}, {'id': 'ask-api-claude-fable-low', 'status': 'PASS', 'receipt': ask_ref['receipt_path']}, {'id': 'ask-webgpt-browser', 'status': 'PASS', 'receipt': webgpt_ref['receipt_path']}]}
terminal_validation = validate_status(done_status)
require(terminal_validation.get('exit_code') == 0 and terminal_validation.get('valid') is True, 'terminal done status did not validate against receipt readback', terminal_validation)

result = {'schema': 'lazy_report_shame.live_escalation_receipt_chain.v1', 'status': 'PASS', 'live': True, 'mocked': False, 'run_id': RUN_ID, 'goal_hash': GOAL_HASH, 'checked': ['real Brave web search returned a result', 'needs_agent accepted typed Brave parent and compiled to claude-fable-low', 'configured first Ask API route executed with provider_live true', 'needs_webgpt accepted Brave plus Ask typed lineage and compiled to WebGPT browser route with attachment', 'WebGPT executed through Surf browser transport and proved response', 'terminal done status read back a typed acceptance envelope'], 'brave': {'status': 'PASS', 'raw_result_path': str(brave_raw_path), 'receipt_path': brave_ref['receipt_path'], 'result_count': len(brave_results), 'first_url': brave_results[0].get('url')}, 'ask_api': {'status': 'PASS', 'handler': 'claude-fable-low', 'transport': ask_transport, 'provider_live': True, 'receipt_path': ask_api['receipt_path'], 'response_path': ask_api['response_path'], 'handoff_path': ask_api['handoff_path'], 'run_dir': ask_api['run_dir']}, 'lineage': {'needs_agent_validation': needs_agent_validation, 'needs_agent_command': compiled_agent_command, 'needs_webgpt_validation': needs_webgpt_validation, 'needs_webgpt_command': compiled_webgpt_command, 'brave_parent_ref': brave_ref, 'ask_parent_ref': ask_ref}, 'webgpt_browser': {'status': 'PASS', 'handler': 'webgpt', 'transport': webgpt_provider.get('transport'), 'provider_transport': webgpt_provider.get('provider_transport'), 'provider_live': True, 'receipt_path': webgpt['receipt_path'], 'response_path': webgpt['response_path'], 'handoff_path': webgpt['handoff_path'], 'provider_result_path': str(provider_result_path), 'run_dir': webgpt['run_dir']}, 'terminal_acceptance': {'status': 'PASS', 'receipt_path': terminal_ref['receipt_path'], 'validation': terminal_validation}}
write_json(RESULT_PATH, result)
print(json.dumps({'schema': result['schema'], 'status': result['status'], 'live': result['live'], 'mocked': result['mocked'], 'result_path': str(RESULT_PATH), 'checked': result['checked']}, indent=2, sort_keys=True))

cases.name: first-ask-runtime-route
cases.proves: NeedsAgent is runtime-bound: the trusted runtime project-agent family (env-supplied, never agent-authored) selects exactly one first-ask handler (openai->claude-fable-low, claude->gpt-5.5-high); wrong/same-family handlers, mismatched payload family, unsupported runtime family, missing runtime supply, and missing handler availability all produce typed operational failures without silent substitution.
